package.name: whill_odometry
package.description: Wheel-odometry wrapper for the upstream ros2_whill/whill_driver, which only publishes /whill/states/model_cr2 (whill_msgs/ModelCr2State) and not a nav_msgs/Odometry. This node integrates the differential drive kinematics from the noetic ros_whill driver and republishes the result on /whill/odom, so Phase A's ekf_odom can fuse wheel + IMU into the Nav2-standard odom -> base_link TF chain. See docs/legacy-findings/whill-wheel-odometry.md and ADR-0001.
